title: What Came Back Home
logline: A woman returns to her home village after years of work abroad, naming places before they come into view, and finds that some of what she remembers is no longer there to be seen.

object.note: Object 5 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: From faces glimpsed and let go to a place long remembered: a woman returning after years of work abroad, the other side of the choice left open in 'Not Yet Decided'.

thread_out.thread: Memory's long echo becomes a literal one: a temple bell struck once at dawn, its sound fading slowly across the valley.

requirements: A family with a member returning from long-term work abroad, willing to be filmed
Access to both the journey and the home over enough time to observe real adjustment
Careful, ongoing consent from the whole family, including any children

suggestions.name: A rural village in the North Western or North Central Province
suggestions.why: Regions with a long history of overseas labour migration and return.
suggestions.verify: A specific family and their willingness to be filmed over time are unconfirmed.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed.
